description: Use only when the user explicitly asks to view, reschedule or cancel existing appointments or manage saved addresses. Opens the existing first-party account portal inside a card, never returns customer data. Never call for general questions or new bookings. The customer signs in and makes changes inside the card on MCP Near Me; never ask to connect or reconnect a ChatGPT account, and never request a phone or code in chat. When a live card is displayed, omit prose or use at most one short neutral sentence in the customer's language, such as: "Details and current status are in the card." Do not repeat companies, dates, times, prices, policies, booking references, status claims, comparisons or next steps outside the card. This applies only to successful card presentation; keep normal intake/choice questions and concise error or unavailable-UI guidance.
name: open_service_account
title: Open secure appointment management
